group_notes.silesia: Group record. Vassals of the Bohemian crown; during the interregnum the dukes and the bishop of Breslau, who was Silesian Landeshauptmann, acted largely independently, and Silesian estates were strongly Catholic and anti-Hussite. Group of minor duchies; game may represent several as small subjects.
group_notes.tusi_group: GROUP record, not a single polity. Hereditary native officials confirmed by Ming; autonomy varied widely. GROUP.
